clue.text: Seducer gets lot of hair mussed up, but not female

indicators.note: hair that is mussed up is tousled, so these letters are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A womaniser's grooming goes awry when his thick mop is ruffled, though no woman did it.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the F (female, signalled by 'but not') from LOTOFHAIR and rearrange the rest, as 'mussed up' says.
explanation.definitionFit: A Lothario is a stock name for a rake who seduces women, from a character in an eighteenth-century play.

clue.text: Liberal marriage vow generates sex urge

parts.note: the words 'I do' are the vow spoken at a wedding

explanation.surface: A permissive wedding promise is said to stir up desire.
explanation.definitionFit: Libido is the psychological term for sexual drive or appetite.

clue.text: Reportedly changed course completely without giving offence

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is said or heard, so the sound of the phrase is what counts

parts.note: to tack is to change course in sailing, so 'tacked fully' is to have changed course completely

explanation.surface: A sailor turned the boat right round, apparently without upsetting anyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting with diplomacy and sensitivity means behaving so that nobody is upset.

clue.text: Tree the French put up and the German put down

indicators.note: in a down entry, put up means written from bottom to top, so the French article is turned round

parts.note: LA is the feminine definite article in French
DER is the masculine definite article in German

explanation.surface: Two foreign articles, one hoisted and one lowered, make a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put down' simply places DER below AL in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: The alder is a deciduous tree of the birch family that grows near water.

clue.text: Quarantine one so overdue

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
something overdue is late

explanation.surface: Someone long overdue should be kept in quarantine.
explanation.definitionFit: To quarantine someone is to keep them apart from others, the verb being a synonym of separate.

clue.text: Furnace tender on the way, approved by Queen

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
OK means approved or agreed
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, a queen

explanation.surface: A man feeding the boiler is on the road with royal blessing.
explanation.definitionFit: A stoker is the worker who feeds fuel into a furnace, such as on a steam ship or engine.

clue.text: Cleaner to change the allowance

indicators.note: change tells us to alter the order of the letters given

explanation.surface: A cleaner is asked to alter the allowance paid.
explanation.definitionFit: In engineering, an allowance is the permitted margin of variation, also called tolerance.

clue.text: Brown-coloured vehicle they say, hits middle of skip

indicators.note: they say means the word is spoken, so its sound gives the letters

parts.note: a car is a vehicle, pronounced like the start of the answer in non-rhotic speech

indicators.note: middle of asks for the central letters of the word skip

explanation.surface: A brown car apparently crashes into the centre of a skip.
explanation.walkthrough: In British speech CAR has no R sound, so it is heard as KHA; skip's middle letters are KI.
explanation.definitionFit: Khaki is a dull yellowish-brown colour, familiar from army uniforms.

clue.text: Tears one off ring

indicators.note: off suggests something gone wrong, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone rips one piece off a ring.
explanation.definitionFit: To resonate is to echo or reverberate, as a bell rings out.

clue.text: Curtain put behind doctor before operation

parts.note: to back something is to put support behind it

explanation.surface: A surgeon is placed behind a screen before surgery.
explanation.definitionFit: A backdrop is a painted cloth hung at the back of a stage, a kind of theatre curtain.

clue.text: Without exception, a learner driver needs manners

parts.note: L is the plate shown by a learner driver in Britain
ways can mean manners or customs

explanation.surface: Every learner driver must mind their manners.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something at all times, with no exceptions, is doing it constantly.

clue.text: There's a flap over stone back inside

indicators.note: back means the hidden letters are read in reverse
inside shows the letters lie within the words flap over

explanation.surface: A flap lies across a stone at the rear.
explanation.definitionFit: An opal is a precious gemstone with a play of colours.

clue.text: Put off when fox's head appears among stags

indicators.note: among puts one piece in the middle of another

parts.note: stags are male deer

indicators.note: head picks out the first letter of fox's

explanation.surface: A fox's head shows up among the stags, causing a postponement.
explanation.definitionFit: To defer is to postpone, a synonym of delay.

clue.text: Like being without one disparaging remark

parts.note: as can mean like, as in 'as a child'

indicators.note: without here means outside, so one piece surrounds another

parts.note: a being is a person
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone lacking any self-worth makes a slighting comment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is the old sense outside, not lacking.
explanation.definitionFit: To cast aspersions is to make slurs or attack someone's character.

clue.text: Sort of hammer needed for cold weather vehicle

definitions.meaning: the word is the short form of the heavy hammer used for breaking stone
a runner-mounted vehicle pulled over snow and ice

explanation.surface: A big hammer is required to build a winter conveyance.
explanation.definitionFit: A sledgehammer is a heavy long-handled hammer; a sled or sleigh is a vehicle for snow.

clue.text: Eating on California railway in this?

definitions.text: Eating on California railway in this?

parts.note: dining means eating
CA is the postal abbreviation for California

explanation.surface: A train carriage where you eat while travelling on a Californian line.
explanation.definitionFit: The whole clue describes the restaurant carriage of a train, where passengers eat while the train moves.

clue.text: Telephone connection not working — it happens in Rugby

parts.note: a line is a telephone connection
out means out of order or not working

explanation.surface: The phone line is down, which is common in the town of Rugby.
explanation.walkthrough: Capital R in Rugby suggests the Warwickshire town, but it is the game.
explanation.definitionFit: In rugby union, a line-out is the restart where forwards jump for a ball thrown in from touch.

clue.text: Watchful, but first out, bowled by Jeeves?

indicators.note: first picks the opening letter of the word out

parts.note: B is the cricket abbreviation for bowled
Jeeves is the famous valet in P G Wodehouse's stories

explanation.surface: Jeeves is alert, but in a cricket match he was bowled out first ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Being observant means noticing things, a synonym of alert.

clue.text: Glaswegian released with harm

parts.note: someone from Glasgow is a Scot
released means set free

explanation.surface: A man from Glasgow is let off without injury.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting away scot-free means escaping without punishment or injury.

clue.text: Condiment from French Guiana? Capital!

definitions.meaning: a hot red pepper powder used to season food
the chief city of the South American territory

explanation.surface: A spice from a South American territory? Excellent!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital!' looks like an exclamation of approval but names the city.
explanation.definitionFit: The pepper is named after the city, which is the capital of French Guiana.

clue.text: Where needles may be required in domestic science tuition

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit within the words that follow

explanation.surface: Sewing needles are needed in home economics lessons.
explanation.definitionFit: An etui is a small ornamental case for holding needles and other sewing items.

clue.text: An important person in Cheshire

definitions.meaning: a big shot, from the phrase 'big ...'
a crumbly English variety named after the county

explanation.surface: A VIP lives in an English county.
explanation.walkthrough: Cheshire is an English county that gives its name to a crumbly cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: A bigwig is called a 'big' one in slang, and Cheshire is a type of English dairy product.

clue.text: Man allowed garland on head

parts.note: a chap is a man
let means allowed

explanation.surface: A man is permitted to wear a wreath.
explanation.definitionFit: A chaplet is a wreath or circlet worn on the head.

clue.text: Champion fed up in front of goal

indicators.note: in front of places the first piece above the second in this down entry
up in a down entry means written bottom to top, so fed is turned round

parts.note: an end is a goal or aim

explanation.surface: A champion, fed up, stands before the goal.
explanation.definitionFit: To champion a cause is to support or protect it, a synonym of uphold.

clue.text: Thanks for trapping an ultra wild spider

indicators.note: trapping means one piece encloses another

parts.note: TA is informal British for thanks

indicators.note: wild means the letters run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: Thanks for catching a really fierce arachnid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wild' rearranges AN ULTRA to ARANTUL, which TA surrounds.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarantula is a large hairy spider.

clue.text: Decorated again with colour the same

parts.note: red is a colour
ID is short for idem, Latin for the same

explanation.surface: A room repainted in a matching shade.
explanation.definitionFit: To redo a room is to redecorate it, so redid is past tense of that.

clue.text: Pile of rocks is concealing second Indian

parts.note: the Cree are a First Nations people of North America

explanation.surface: A heap of stones hides a moment's glimpse of a Native American.
explanation.definitionFit: Scree is loose broken stone lying on a mountain slope.

clue.text: Leather dominated, one hears

indicators.note: one hears means the sound of a word is what matters

parts.note: swayed means influenced or dominated

explanation.surface: Someone is overheard saying a leather item ruled them.
explanation.definitionFit: Suede is leather with a napped, velvety finish.

clue.text: Military engineers have Mussolini cut down

parts.note: RE stands for Royal Engineers, the British army corps
Il Duce was Mussolini's title as Italian dictator

explanation.surface: Army sappers have the Italian dictator trimmed.
explanation.definitionFit: To reduce is to lessen or cut back.

clue.text: For example, ET had food to turn away

parts.note: ET is the film's extraterrestrial, an example of a being from space
ate means had food

explanation.surface: The film's extraterrestrial ate his meal and then turned away.
explanation.definitionFit: To alienate is to estrange or drive away.

clue.text: Continue under wrong direction

indicators.note: wrong means the letters are put in the wrong order

parts.note: E is east, a compass direction

explanation.surface: Keep going while heading in the wrong direction.
explanation.definitionFit: To endure is to last or persist.

clue.text: At trial newspaperman was a witness

parts.note: a test is a trial
ED is short for editor, a newspaperman

explanation.surface: A journalist gave evidence at a court hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: To attest is to bear witness, certifying something is true.
